name: Birthing on Country Placement Bursary (SCU)
summary: A $2,500 bursary for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander SCU midwifery students on a placement at an Aboriginal Health Service.
who: Identify as an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Enrolled or intending to enrol in a Midwifery Professional Experience unit.
Available to attend the Birthing on Country placement and present to peers about it.
how: Apply through the online form linked from the bursary page.
catches: Open until places are filled or project funds run out.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Birthing on Country Placement Bursary

evidence.quote: Applicants must identify as an Aboriginal person and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
